title: Find your way around
body:
Home brings your current work together. Open All features to find tools, or Work to see what needs attention. Account holds your display, privacy and data settings.

Your chapter and role determine which tools you can use. A public chapter listing is reference information: choosing a listing does not give you membership or permission.

Use Refresh when you want current information. If a connection fails, check the error before trying again. A saved public guide is a local copy and may be older than the current app.
